root_cause.note: Compute-domain daemon restarts a configured command line from the DRA device plugin config.

evidence.analysis: The compute-domain daemon executes m.cmd from its config (ConfigMap-sourced). The sink is real but the input is admin-controlled config, not tenant PVC data; recorded as a config-trust boundary for DRA deployments, plus the kubeletplugin.yaml privileged/hostPath posture (elevated-pod-spec hits).
